text:
Priya (CS): Heads-up: Catalyst Inc needs an enablement runway next week. They asked for two 30m office hours + one 90m deep-dive workshop. Can we schedule without touching renewal items?

Tom (Enablement): I can run the 90m on Fri, and 30m office hours Mon/Thu. Suggest Mon 09:00 PT / Thu 17:00 CET for office hours. Keep deep-dive as hands-on model tuning + Q&A.

Evan (SuccessOps): Mon 09:00 PT ok. I'll set reminders at 48h and 1h and enable the 3-question pulse after each session.

Nora (AM): Note: finance contact is tagged high-risk. Exclude attachments and don’t include pricing in slides. CS will handle renewal separately.

Tom (Enablement): Draft invite blurb:
```
Redwood Enablement — Catalyst Inc
Office hours: Mon 2026-04-20 09:00 PT; Thu 2026-04-23 17:00 CET (30m)
Workshop: Fri 2026-04-24 10:00 PT (90m)
Agenda: OH = quick triage (15m) + Q&A (15m). Workshop = config deep-dive (45m) + hands-on tweaks (30m) + wrap (15m)
Prework: API key, sample prompts, baseline perf numbers
Notes: Invite limited to admin+eng; no contract/price details in materials
```

Evan (SuccessOps): I'll attach prework checklist and a short troubleshooting snippet. Also will add an RSVP cap to prevent overloaded labs.

CalBot: Poll started: preferred workshop time 10:00 PT vs 13:00 PT. 6 votes so far. (link)

Nora (AM): I'll coordinate dev keys for the workshop lab and share SSO mapping with Tom.

Priya (CS): Action items: Tom — finalize slides & workshop exercises; Evan — reminders + pulse + cap; Nora — dev keys + SSO; Priya — CRM tag: enablement_followup and renewal_handshake="post-workshop".

Tom (Enablement): Will post calendar invites and slide deck by EOD tomorrow. Planning to record workshop but mark as opt-out.

Evan (SuccessOps): Recording opt-out set; feedback forms ready. I'll surface attendee list to CS once RSVP closes.

CalBot: Calendar invites sent to 9 Catalyst contacts. Reminders queued.
